title: BrainQuake example SEEG data: ictal and interictal stereo-EEG from 8 epilepsy patients (Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital)
description: This dataset contains stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 8 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, recorded at the Epilepsy Center of Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital during pre-surgical monitoring. It includes a 71-second ictal clip and an interictal segment of up to about 2 hours per patient, sampled at 2000 Hz. The data were released as example data for the BrainQuake toolbox (epileptogenicity index and high-frequency event analysis) and reorganised into iEEG-BIDS without signal processing.
methods_description: SEEG depth electrode recordings were acquired at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. Ictal clips (71 s) and interictal segments were exported as EDF/EDF+D files. MRI was acquired before and CT after electrode implantation. Interictal EDF+ annotations are listed in the events files. The BIDS conversion involved no signal processing.

funding_references.funder_name: National Key R&D Program of China
